# Emoji Maker

Emoji maker: custom emoji generated from your description in the glossy emoji look, for Slack, Discord and chats.

## What it does
Describe the emoji. Claude tells you the price and creates it as a square image.

**How the files are made:** each emoji is generated by an image model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Square image files; resize to your platform's emoji size before uploading.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install emoji-maker@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Emoji Maker talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/emoji/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each emoji uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The emoji show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_emoji_models` | Models for emojis with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_emoji_cost` | Exact price of one emoji before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_emoji` | Starts one emoji in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_emoji` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A cat drinking coffee emoji"
- "A rocket wearing sunglasses"
- "A thumbs up made of pizza"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the emoji (the description of the emoji) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
